```{r}
lowerTriangle <- function(m){
  return(m[lower.tri(m)])
}

cosine_matrix = function(raw_data){
    # rel*rel matrix caculated by cosine similarity
    n <- nrow(raw_data)  # raw_data is an n x n matrix, 159*dimensions
    # create an empty matrix to store cosine similarity
    raw_data_cor <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = n)
    colnames(raw_data_cor) <- rownames(raw_data)
    rownames(raw_data_cor) <- rownames(raw_data)
    # calculate the cosine similarity of the upper triangular part
    for (i in 1:(n - 1)) {
        for (j in (i + 1):n) {
            cosine_value <- cosine(as.numeric(raw_data[i, ]), as.numeric(raw_data[j, ]))
            raw_data_cor[i, j] <- cosine_value
        }
    }
    # symmetrically fill the cosine similarity in the lower triangular part
    raw_data_cor <- raw_data_cor + t(raw_data_cor)

    # set the diagonal to 1
    diag(raw_data_cor) <- 1
    return(raw_data_cor)
}
```

## ancient bert
```{r}
#csim_ancient=read.csv('sim_bert_embedding/ancient/q3.2_bert_embedding_data/MASK_embedding_output.csv',check.names=FALSE, fileEncoding = "gb18030")

raw_data = read.csv('sim_bert_embedding/ancient/q3.2_bert_embedding_data/MASK_embedding_output.csv', check.names=FALSE, fileEncoding = "gb18030")

row_names = raw_data[, 1]
data_matrix = raw_data[, -1]

# 处理重复行名：对重复项取平均值并保留第一个重复项
unique_names = unique(row_names)

result_matrix = matrix(NA, nrow = length(unique_names), ncol = ncol(data_matrix))
rownames(result_matrix) = unique_names
colnames(result_matrix) = colnames(data_matrix)

for (i in seq_along(unique_names)) {
  name = unique_names[i]
  rows_idx = which(row_names == name)
  if (length(rows_idx) > 1) {
    result_matrix[i, ] = colMeans(data_matrix[rows_idx, , drop = FALSE])
  } else {
    result_matrix[i, ] = as.numeric(data_matrix[rows_idx, ])
  }
}
csim_ancient_df = as.data.frame(result_matrix)

rels_order_ancient = rownames(csim_ancient_df)
csim_ancient = lowerTriangle(csim_ancient_df)

predict_33d = human_123r_33d[rels_order_ancient,]
dim(predict_33d)
model_sim_array = data.frame(matrix(nrow=7140,ncol=16))
colnames(model_sim_array) = models
model_sim_dict = list()
for (model_name in models) {
    model_vector <- get(model_name) 
    model_sim = cosine_matrix(predict_33d[,model_vector]) 
    model_sim_dict[[model_name]] = model_sim 
    model_sim_array[model_name] = lowerTriangle(model_sim)
}
berta.result.cor = data.frame(cor(cbind(model_sim_array,csim_ancient)))
```

# Null Distribution
```{r}
human_rating = human_123r_33d
colnames(human_rating) <- c("Activity Intensity", "Mating", "Intimacy", "Generation Gap", "Attachment", "Trust", "Information Exchange", "Communal Sharing", "Valence Evaluation", "Concreteness", "Conflict", "Visibility", "Synchronicity", "Morality evaluation", "Good Exchange", "Importance for individuals", "Importance for society", "Equality", "Coercion", "Endurance", "Service Exchange", "Expected Reciprocity", "Formality and Regulation", "Love Expression", "Uniqueness", "Strategic", "Socioemotional", "Activeness", "Spatial Distance", "Occupational", "Affiliation Coalition", "Negotiation", "Money Exchange")
human_rating_outModel <- human_rating[, -which(colnames(human_rating) %in% FAVEE_model)]
```

## Modern bert
### 5 dimensions
```{r}

bertm_r_distri = c()

for(i in c(1:10000)){
    selected_columns <- sample(names(human_rating_outModel), 5)
    human_rating_selected <- human_rating_outModel[, selected_columns]
    human_distance_vector <- -c(dist(human_rating_selected))

    #r <- as.numeric(cor.test(csim_modern, human_distance_vector, method = 'spearman')$estimate)
     r <- cor(csim_modern, human_distance_vector, method = 'spearman', use = "complete.obs")
    bertm_r_distri <- c(bertm_r_distri, r)
}
     
```

# Plot results
```{r}
my.color = c('modern'="#a17db4",'FAVEE_model'='red')

null_distri = data.frame(modern = bertm_r_distri)
null_distri_melt = melt(null_distri)
null_distri_melt$'variable' = factor(null_distri_melt$'variable',
                                     levels = c('modern'))
null_distri_melt = null_distri_melt[null_distri_melt$'variable'%in%c('modern'),] 
rsa_cor_melt = rsa_cor_melt[rsa_cor_melt$'variable'%in%c('modern'),]    

```

```{r}
png("output_graph/model_compare.png", bg="transparent", 
    family = 'sans', units='in', width=10, height=10, res=300)

options(repr.plot.width = 10, repr.plot.height=10)

ggplot() +
    geom_violin(data = null_distri_melt, 
                aes(x = variable, y = value, fill = variable, color = variable),
                position = position_nudge(x = 0.2), 
                adjust = 1.2, trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(data = null_distri_melt, 
                 aes(x = variable, y = value, color = variable),
                 position = position_nudge(x = 0.2),
                 linewidth = 1.5, outlier.alpha = 0, width = 0.05) +
    geom_point(data = rsa_cor_melt, 
               aes(x = as.numeric(variable) - 0.15, y = value, color = model),
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.04, seed = 123), 
               size = 12, shape = 20, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values=my.color, na.value="grey60")+
    scale_fill_manual(values=my.color)+
    
    theme_classic()+
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size=30, color="black"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size=40, color="black"), 
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_line(linetype=1, color="black", linewidth=2),
          legend.position = 'none')

dev.off()
```
